name: Alpenhof
beschreibung: The Alpenhof is situated in the municipality of Tux at an altitude of around 1,300 metres in the Tux Valley. The hotel serves as a base for activities in both summer and winter, including excursions to the skiing and hiking areas around the Hintertux Glacier. Amenities include a restaurant serving regional cuisine as well as a wellness area complete with a sauna and swimming pool. The rooms are decorated in an alpine style and feature balconies with views of the surrounding peaks. This is a family-run establishment where guests can enjoy a peaceful stay well away from through traffic.
